Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce Wedding Speculation Intensifies Amid Permit Reports

Reports of permit requests for street closures and potential multi-day celebrations in New York City have fueled intense speculation about a possible wedding between Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce. While some outlets highlight the buzz and potential venue details, others note social media backlash to the rumored Madison Square Garden ceremony. Travis Kelce's father has expressed excitement for the couple.
